name: Kirisaki Chitoge
source:
The daughter of the leader of the Bee Hive Gangsters, Chitoge transfers from America to [url=/c23699]Raku's[/url] high school at the start of the series. She and Raku pretend to be in a relationship in order to prevent their families' factions from feuding. She is half-Japanese with long blonde hair that is tied with a ribbon. Her mother, Hana, is a powerful CEO in America. She is good at sports and academics, but clueless when it comes to cooking. 
Despite not getting along with Raku from the start, she makes an effort to find his lost pendant. Ten years before, Chitoge makes a promise with a boy; when she looks through her diary from that time, she stumbles upon a key that could potentially unlock Raku's locket.
